definitions.visible_hidden: visible = apple surface voxel containing >=1 GT apple surface sample visible in the grasping-hand wrist camera at that request (t84 visible_wrist v3: projects inside image, segmentation = apple geom, render depth >= point depth - 5 mm); hidden = not visible. Sums are lead's replay_metrics.json sum_n_left_visible_nb / sum_n_left_hidden_nb; verifier adds request medians of n_left_visible_nb / n_left_hidden_nb over the same 78 requests (part_w0/w1.json rows)
definitions.scene_request_selection: per run (REG_ep211_s2113 touching banana, HURDLE_ep1345_s13453 separated): among that run's requests in the 78-request remaining-voxel set, the one with the smallest palm-apple distance (part json palm_apple_mm); tie -> smaller request index
definitions.scene_overlay: per arm, recomputed from that arm's chunk esdf_free grid at the selected request: band-excluded GT apple surface voxels (same voxel keys as t84 voxel_metric) coloured by hand-layer value d (mm, continuous colormap, clipped [-5, 20]); remaining = d <= 0 (black edge). Neighbour-fruit freed voxels = freed_w*.npz points of class 'fruit' for that request and arm (B0p has none by definition). GT outlines = MuJoCo segmentation boundary of apple and of neighbour fruit geoms in the wrist render; slice = horizontal layer of esdf_free through the voxel containing the GT apple centre, GT samples within +-half voxel of that z drawn as outline points
definitions.supplement_region_excluding_hurdle211: T97 region criteria recomputed with t97_region_agg.py logic unchanged but rows with run == '허들211_k0' removed (memory rule: hurdle 211 excluded from all tests). Reported as supplement; lead's D30 numbers are the 304-request set including hurdle 211
definitions.supplement_t97_separated: T97 §2.2 criterion 2 auxiliary: request median of frac_left_nb over the 78-request set minus the 회귀211 run (touching banana), for B0p / P0f / C2f; plus run medians (lead's). Threshold as task: C2f <= P0f + 0.01
definitions.tolerances: no tolerance: numbers are reported raw (4 decimals as in lead files)
